headline: Vote on funding a new Portland Fish Exchange website, and review of a Vessel Services request and lease.
summary: A possible vote on website funding is on the agenda. Officials will also review a Vessel Services request, and the Marine Trade Center rent reduction is listed for a construction update.
items: Financial update from Kaela Gonzalez, Program Coordinator
Facilities update from Phil DiPierro, Project Manager
Portland Fish Exchange subcommittee update from Matt Moretti, including the manager's report and general manager update
Possible vote on funding for a new Portland Fish Exchange website
Review and discussion of Vessel Services request, with public comment
Construction update on Marine Trade Center rent reduction per Public Works
Verbal staff update from Heather Moretti, Waterfront Coordinator
